title: Simon 6.3.2(1): integer combinations of integer multiplicity currents are integer multiplicity
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, and let T₁, T₂, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U), where T₁ and T₂ are integer multiplicity (each represented by an IMRep in U). Let p₁, p₂ ∈ ℤ with S(ω) = p₁T₁(ω) + p₂T₂(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U). Then S is integer multiplicity, i.e. S = τ(M', θ', ξ') for some IMRep (M', θ', ξ') in U.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T₁ T₂ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (p₁ p₂ : ℤ), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₂ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, S ω = (p₁ : ℝ) * T₁ ω + (p₂ : ℝ) * T₂ ω) → IsIntegerMultiplicity S
